name: black-friday-last-year-report
description: Use for "how did our ads do last Black Friday", "which campaigns actually drove store sales last BFCM", "which products carried last year's Black Friday", "when did our Black Friday orders peak last year", or "how much did CPMs rise last Black Friday". Use weeks before a Black Friday, Cyber Monday or Prime Day sale, when the decision is what to repeat and what to drop. Google Ads, Facebook Ads, TikTok Ads and Shopify.
